title: shop: product overview
description: The product on one screen: visitors, sign-ups and active users against the previous period, each week's new and returning users, the figures that moved, the visit → sign-up → activation funnel, where visitors come from, whether sign-ups come back, and what people use. Each block links to the tab with its detail, and counts what that tab counts. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Visitors
panels.description: Distinct visitor-days in the range (the platform's cookieless daily hash: one person on two days is two). The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
first AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, toDate(max(stop)) AS d,
         argMin(multiIf(
  med IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search') OR click IN ('google', 'microsoft'), 'Paid search',
  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',
  med IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'programmatic'), 'Display',
  med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter'), 'Email',
  med = 'affiliate', 'Affiliate',
  match(ref, '(^|\\.)(chatgpt\\.com|chat\\.openai\\.com|perplexity\\.ai|claude\\.ai|gemini\\.google\\.com|copilot\\.microsoft\\.com|you\\.com)$')
    OR src IN ('chatgpt.com', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'claude'), 'AI assistants',
  med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm')
    OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(facebook|instagram|linkedin|lnkd|reddit|youtube|tiktok|pinterest|threads|bsky|mastodon|t)\\.(com|co|in|app|social|net)$|(^|\\.)(x\\.com|news\\.ycombinator\\.com)$'), 'Organic social',
  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',
  src != '' OR med != '', 'Other campaign',
  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,
         argMin(entry_route, start) AS landing,
         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,
         count() AS n_visits, countIf(views = 1 AND actions = 0) AS bounces
  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h)
SELECT count() AS "Visitors" FROM first

panels.title: Sign-ups
panels.description: Users whose first auth_signed_up is in the range. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d)
SELECT count() AS "Sign-ups" FROM su_h

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with any signed-in product event in the range, as the Users tab counts them; under it, the daily, weekly and monthly active users of the range's last UTC day. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT (SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))) AS "Active users",
       sumIf(dau, day = toDate({to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 SECOND)) AS "DAU",
       sumIf(wau, day = toDate({to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 SECOND)) AS "WAU",
       sumIf(mau, day = toDate({to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 SECOND)) AS "MAU"
FROM (
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset = 0) AS dau, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset < 7) AS wau, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS mau
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT EnvId, UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(30) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day)
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

stitch AS (

  FROM product_events

  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,

SELECT v.day AS day, round(ifNull(s.n, 0) / v.n, 4) AS "Visit to sign-up"
FROM (SELECT d AS day, count() AS n FROM first GROUP BY day) AS v

panels.title: Active users, new and returning
panels.description: Each ISO week's active users: new (whose sign-up, or first event where sign-ups are not reported, is in that week) and returning (everyone else active that week). New is the Users tab's lifecycle New; returning is its Retained and Resurrected. "since" a day when New is counted only from it.
panels.sql:
WITH
u AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, groupUniqArray(toMonday(Timestamp)) AS wks
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= toMonday({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId),
s AS (SELECT EnvId, UserId, toMonday(NewAt) AS sw FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)))
SELECT week, countIf(state = 'new') AS "New", countIf(state = 'returning') AS "Returning"
FROM (
  SELECT wk AS week, if(s.sw = wk, 'new', 'returning') AS state
  FROM u ARRAY JOIN u.wks AS wk
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.EnvId = u.EnvId AND s.UserId = u.UserId)
WHERE week >= toMonday({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(week) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
panels.subtitleSql:
SELECT if(decided > {from:DateTime64(9)}, concat('since ', replaceRegexpOne(formatDateTime(decided, '%d %b', 'UTC'), '^0', '')), '') AS "Subtitle"
FROM (SELECT (SELECT max(DecidedFrom) FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, minIf(first_at, k = 'u') AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, minIf(first_at, k = 's'), minIf(first_at, k = 'u') + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
  SELECT 'u' AS k, EnvId, first_at, has_signup FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 's' AS k, EnvId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, toUInt8(0) AS has_signup
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 400 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
  GROUP BY EnvId)
GROUP BY EnvId
HAVING countIf(k = 'u') > 0) WHERE ReportsSignups = 1) AS decided)

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: The figures that moved by 5% or more against the comparison, the ones that moved the wrong way first, then those that improved. A declared comparison of each figure with its own earlier value, not a statistical test.

figures.title: Activation rate
figures.description: The share of the range's sign-ups that reached the first <entity>_created event (the automatic CRUD event) within 7d: the funnel's last step over its sign-ups.
figures.sql:
WITH su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
act AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND match(EventName, '_created$') AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
SELECT round(countIf(x.UserId != '' AND x.at >= s.at AND x.at < s.at + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND) / nullIf(count(), 0), 4) AS "Activation rate"
FROM su AS s LEFT JOIN act AS x ON x.EnvId = s.EnvId AND x.UserId = s.UserId

figures.title: Bounce rate
figures.description: The share of visits with exactly one page view and nothing else.
figures.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)
SELECT round(avg(views = 1 AND actions = 0), 4) AS "Bounce rate" FROM visits

figures.title: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)
figures.description: The average daily active users over the average 30-day active users.
figures.sql:
SELECT round(avg(dau) / nullIf(avg(mau), 0), 4) AS "DAU / MAU"
FROM (
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset = 0) AS dau, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS mau
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT EnvId, UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(30) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day)

panels.title: Visit → sign-up → activation
panels.description: Visitor-days in the range, the range's sign-ups, and those that reached the first <entity>_created event (the automatic CRUD event) within 7d of signing up, as the Product tab counts them. The first step counts visitor-days, the others persons.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (

  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'

  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events

    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d),

panels.title: Where visitors come from
panels.description: Visitor-days by the channel of their first visit, the sign-ups each brought and its conversion, as the Acquisition tab counts them. The trend is each channel's visitor-days per UTC day.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
first AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, toDate(max(stop)) AS d,
         argMin(multiIf(
  med IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search') OR click IN ('google', 'microsoft'), 'Paid search',
  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',
  med IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'programmatic'), 'Display',
  med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter'), 'Email',
  med = 'affiliate', 'Affiliate',
  match(ref, '(^|\\.)(chatgpt\\.com|chat\\.openai\\.com|perplexity\\.ai|claude\\.ai|gemini\\.google\\.com|copilot\\.microsoft\\.com|you\\.com)$')
    OR src IN ('chatgpt.com', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'claude'), 'AI assistants',
  med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm')
    OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(facebook|instagram|linkedin|lnkd|reddit|youtube|tiktok|pinterest|threads|bsky|mastodon|t)\\.(com|co|in|app|social|net)$|(^|\\.)(x\\.com|news\\.ycombinator\\.com)$'), 'Organic social',
  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',
  src != '' OR med != '', 'Other campaign',
  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,
         argMin(entry_route, start) AS landing,
         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,
         count() AS n_visits, countIf(views = 1 AND actions = 0) AS bounces
  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h),
stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d),
act AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND match(EventName, '_created$') AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId),
v AS (SELECT ifNull(toString(channel), '') AS k0, uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS visitors, sum(n_visits) AS visits, sum(bounces) AS bounces
      FROM first GROUP BY k0),
s AS (SELECT if(ifNull(f.h, '') = '', 'Unattributed', ifNull(toString(channel), '')) AS k0, count() AS signups, countIf(x.UserId != '' AND x.at >= u.at AND x.at < u.at + INTERVAL 604800 SECOND) AS activated
      FROM su_h AS u LEFT JOIN first AS f ON f.EnvId = u.EnvId AND f.h = u.h
      LEFT JOIN act AS x ON x.EnvId = u.EnvId AND x.UserId = u.UserId
      GROUP BY k0)
SELECT if(ifNull(v.visitors, 0) > 0, v.k0, s.k0) AS "Channel",
       ifNull(v.visitors, 0) AS "Visitors",
       ifNull(s.signups, 0) AS "Sign-ups",
       round(100 * ifNull(s.signups, 0) / nullIf(ifNull(v.visitors, 0), 0), 2) AS "Conversion %"
FROM v FULL OUTER JOIN s ON v.k0 = s.k0
ORDER BY "Visitors" DESC, "Channel" LIMIT 10

         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
first AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, toDate(max(stop)) AS d,
         argMin(multiIf(
  med IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search') OR click IN ('google', 'microsoft'), 'Paid search',
  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',
  med IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'programmatic'), 'Display',
  med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter'), 'Email',
  med = 'affiliate', 'Affiliate',
  match(ref, '(^|\\.)(chatgpt\\.com|chat\\.openai\\.com|perplexity\\.ai|claude\\.ai|gemini\\.google\\.com|copilot\\.microsoft\\.com|you\\.com)$')
    OR src IN ('chatgpt.com', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'claude'), 'AI assistants',
  med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm')
    OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(facebook|instagram|linkedin|lnkd|reddit|youtube|tiktok|pinterest|threads|bsky|mastodon|t)\\.(com|co|in|app|social|net)$|(^|\\.)(x\\.com|news\\.ycombinator\\.com)$'), 'Organic social',
  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',
  src != '' OR med != '', 'Other campaign',
  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,
         argMin(entry_route, start) AS landing,
         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,
         count() AS n_visits, countIf(views = 1 AND actions = 0) AS bounces
  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h)
SELECT d AS day, channel, count() AS "Visitors" FROM first GROUP BY day, channel ORDER BY day, channel

panels.title: Weekly retention by sign-up cohort
panels.description: The last six weekly cohorts of new users, and the share of each active in its first six weeks (W0 is the sign-up week). The Users tab has twelve.
panels.sql:
SELECT concat(toString(cohort), ' · ', toString(count()), if(count() = 1, ' user', ' users')) AS "Cohort (week of)",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 0 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 0 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W0",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 1 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 1 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W1",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 2 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 2 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W2",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 3 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 3 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W3",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 4 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 4 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W4",
       if(toDateTime(cohort + INTERVAL 5 WEEK) < {to:DateTime64(9)}, round(countIf(has(weeks, cohort + INTERVAL 5 WEEK)) / count(), 4), NULL) AS "W5"
FROM (
    SELECT c.cohort AS cohort, a.weeks AS weeks
    FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, toMonday(NewAt) AS cohort FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY))
          WHERE NewAt >= toMonday({to:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 5 WEEK) AS c
    INNER JOIN (SELECT EnvId, UserId, groupUniqArray(toMonday(Timestamp)) AS weeks
                FROM product_events
                WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= toMonday({to:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 5 WEEK AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
                GROUP BY EnvId, UserId) AS a
      ON a.EnvId = c.EnvId AND a.UserId = c.UserId)
GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Routes by the visitor-days that viewed them, as the Product tab's Pages counts them. The trend is each route's per UTC day.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT Props['route'] AS "Route", uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors"
FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed'
GROUP BY "Route" ORDER BY "Visitors" DESC, "Route" LIMIT 10
panels.trendSql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT toDate(ts) AS day, Props['route'] AS route, uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors"
FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed'
  AND Props['route'] IN (SELECT Props['route'] FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' GROUP BY Props['route'] ORDER BY uniqExact((EnvId, h)) DESC, Props['route'] LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day, route

panels.title: Top features
panels.description: The app's own product events (page views, auth and flag events left out) by the people who used them: a signed-in user, the user a same-day sign-in links a visitor to, else the visitor-day. Empty until the app records an event of its own.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName NOT IN ('page_viewed', 'page_engaged', 'flag_evaluated') AND NOT startsWith(EventName, 'auth_')) AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor)
SELECT EventName AS "Event", uniqExactIf((EnvId, person), person != '') AS "People", count() AS "Events"
FROM persons
GROUP BY EventName HAVING "People" > 0 ORDER BY "People" DESC, "Event" LIMIT 10
